subject: Checking Q3 budget & timeline Atlas Analytics / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's call - Atlas Analytics / Redwood

Hi Sanjay (and Priya),

Thanks again for your time on the call this morning - really helpful to understand Atlas's goals for Q3 around faster model iteration and cutting per-token inference cost for the recommendation pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary (TL;DR):
- Goal: reduce inference latency for user-facing recs and move offline re-ranking to a cost-optimized pipeline.
- Success metric: 30% lower per-token cost on the serving side and sub-150ms P95 latency for 2k concurrent users.

Key technical notes:
- You'd likely benefit from a dedicated Redwood pool for production (predictable throughput) + prefix caching for repeated contexts.
- We discussed a pilot scope focused on the top rec-serving flow (approx. 1M tokens/day).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll send a draft SOW + Q3 pricing (attached).
2) If procurement/budget allows, plan a 6-week pilot targeting the rec-serving flow.
3) We align on success metrics and a simple rollout plan (canary -> full).

Ask: Can you confirm if the pilot/budget is still expected to be approved this quarter (end of June)? If not, what's the revised timing or blocker we should be aware of?

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_sheet_Q3.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf

If easier, happy to do a 20-min sync next week to tighten scope.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference - production-first inference platform

Neha -

Thanks for the summary and the materials. Quick notes from our side:
- We had a productive internal discussion; the team likes the proposed pilot approach.
- Our procurement window for Q3 finalization is tight - budget approvals are scheduled for discussion in the last week of June. Finance will likely sign off if we can show a clear ROI and a conservative pilot scope.

Could you send a 1-page ROI slide plus a trimmed-down SOW (scoped to just the rec-serving flow) - that will help speed approvals. Also copying Priya, who will coordinate with Procurement.

On timing: tentatively still aiming for Q3 pilots, but I can't promise final approval until finance meets.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering | Atlas Analytics
